tha-ap468:1.1: Avaṭaphaliya.] Sataraṃsī nāma bhagavā sayambhū aparājito / vivekakāmo sambuddho gocarāyābhinikkhami // //
tha-ap468:2.1: Phalahattho ahaṃ disvā upagacchiṃ narāsabhaṃ / pasannacitto sumano adāsim avaṭaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap468:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap468:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Avaṭaphaliyo th. i. g. a-ti.
